question: Viruses of the Poxviridae family of clinical interest for humans:

options.opa: They include smallpox, bovine smallpox, vaccinia and molluscum contagiosum.
options.opb: They replicate in the mitochondria of the cell.
options.opc: They require the retrotranscription of their genome.
options.opd: Their infections are commonly associated with viral hepatitis.
